requirements: New evidence must satisfy all gates for at least one archetype.
Complete core coverage, deterministic valuation and all veto ownership before any buy.

early_exit_record.statement: IC was intentionally not run because no investable archetype remains reachable.

archetype_rationale: 조기 종료: 현재 decision score와 조건으로 도달 가능한 유형 없음
falsifiers: If Kidney/Gen 3 fail and U.S. transplant-volume growth slows, independent upside paths contract materially.
If service gross margin rises sustainably while capex intensity falls, Bear residual value should be raised.
A major reimbursement, FDA or aviation-safety event would materially worsen permanent-loss probability.
If service revenue grows while service gross margin falls persistently, unit economics weaken.
If large centers reduce OCS/NOP utilization despite stable transplant volumes, retention should be rescored down.
Loss of reimbursement precedent would directly weaken customer ROI.
If OCS utilization stalls despite transplant growth, the adoption-curve score should fall.
If Kidney/Gen 3 fail to broaden the platform, optionality should be rescored lower.
If hospitals achieve similar utilization gains with materially cheaper alternatives, cost/performance disruption weakens.
If owner FCF/share remains below $2 after the current investment cycle while revenue growth falls below the mid-teens, Base value should be reduced.
If OCS Kidney/Gen 3 and Europe scale with improving service margins, the Base path should be revised upward.
If price rises above locked Bull value without commensurate evidence, V7 should be re-opened.
If OCF turns negative while cash falls and debt/lease obligations rise, stress-survival should be cut sharply.
If the convert is refinanced on unfavorable terms or common-share dilution accelerates above 3%-5% annually, dilution risk rises.
Sustained FCF recovery above capex and SBC would justify higher survival scores.
If 2027-2028 growth falls to low single digits before Kidney/international contribution, the five-year opportunity score should be cut.
A successful Kidney launch with strong unit economics would extend duration and opportunity scale.
A meaningful price discount to unchanged Base economics could raise the market-misperception score.
Failure to remediate the material weakness would materially lower governance integrity.
If Kidney/Gen3/PAD investments do not earn attractive returns, capital-allocation score should fall.
Successful remediation plus improving per-share FCF would support a higher score.
If large centers multi-source away from OCS without workflow disruption, switching moat is weaker than assumed.
If service margin fails to improve with route density, network effects are overstated.
Loss of a key patent/approval or supplier disruption would weaken moat trajectory.
If owner FCF/share does not recover despite revenue growth, incremental ROIC should be cut below cost-of-capital quality.
If Kidney/Gen3 convert R&D into high-margin revenue and working capital normalizes, FCF/share quality should be raised.
If capex+R&D remains above OCF for years without margin improvement, the reinvestment thesis fails.
If U.S. OCS transplant growth falls below transplant-market growth for several years, category leadership weakens.
If Kidney/Gen 3 fail to expand the platform, durability should be reduced.
If reimbursement rules materially reduce NOP/OCS economics, secular durability falls.
decision_authority: Deterministic eligibility and veto gates; IC may reduce deployment within configured caps.
